text:
Maria Gomez: hey all — heads up, i'm delayed boarding and won't be able to take the first 2h of my 18:00-02:00 UTC primary. need a short-handback plan, there was a low-priority pg rolling into pager last night (see incident bot below) so i'd prefer a short coverage swap rather than full rotation. sorry for the late ping :grimacing:

OpsBot: :rotating_light: Pager routed to on-call primary (Maria Gomez) — INCIDENT-4821 — Error spike on /generate-tokens — severity: SEV3 — link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4821 — pages sent to primary at 17:43 UTC

Samir Patel: I can pick up the first 2h. I'll shadow + own the pager until ~20:00 UTC, then hand back if things are calm. @Maria any outstanding runbook steps i should be aware of? :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: thank you so much @Samir :pray: main thing is check the rate-limiter queue and KV-cache memory pressure. runbook here: https://confluence.redwood/company/runbooks/incident-4821 — quick snippet to check queue counts:```bash
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/queues | jq '.rate_limiter[] | {name, pending: .pending}'
```

Alex Kim: @Samir i'll be secondary for the shift. if anything escalates and you need extra hands ping me and i'll take first responder. also leaving my phone on for pager forward. :phone:

Jin Park: if you need a fast mitigation, the hotfix that reduced token-gen load last week was toggling `ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=false` in the routing layer — it bought us ~40% CPU. full note in the runbook under "mitigations -> quick toggles"

Samir Patel: got it. i'll run the queue check now and post results. if we see >500 pending i'll trigger the cache toggle. will also watch latency percentiles.

Samir Patel: queue check results: `auth-rl: 82 pending, generate-rl: 612 pending, embed-rl: 12 pending`. 612 is the one. starting mitigation now: toggling prefix cache in staging to validate then will flip in prod if steady.

Maria Gomez: appreciate it. if you flip prod, use the canary route first (10% traffic) for 5m and watch 95p latency. runbook snippet:```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  duration_m: 5
metrics_to_watch:
  - name: generate_latency_95p
  - name: downstream_errors_5m
```

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied (canary 10%) by Samir Patel at 18:12 UTC — monitoring metrics for 10m — incident page updated: https://redwood.ops/incidents/4821/mitigations

Alex Kim: watching dashboards with you. if the canary holds for 10m, we can roll to 50% then full. i'll be ready to help promote.

Samir Patel: canary looks stable at 18:20 UTC — generate_latency_95p down from 1.8s -> 1.1s, downstream errors flat. promoting to 50% now.

Jin Park: nice. after 50% wait 5m and promote to 100% if no spike in downstream_errors_5m. also file a postmortem note with the customer impact check template once resolved (link in runbook).

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation promoted to 50% at 18:26 UTC by Samir Patel — continuing to monitor.

Samir Patel: promoting to 100% at 18:31 UTC. no sign of regression. taking full ownership until 20:00 UTC as planned.

Maria Gomez: thanks everyone — i'll join at 20:00 to take primary back. @Alex please confirm secondary remains available for overnight.

Alex Kim: confirmed. i'm on for the rest of the night as secondary. if anything pops after 22:00 UTC and someone needs sleep i'll swap with Jin (we discussed earlier).

Samir Patel: leaving a short handoff note: mitigation toggled prefix cache -> reduced 95p latency; queue back to 120 pending; no customer-facing errors observed. i'll add details to incident-4821 and mark as monitoring. handing back to Maria at 20:00 UTC.

Maria Gomez: perfect. i'll take full triage at 20:00, will run the postmortem template and check customer impact matrix. thanks all for quick coverage and sorry again for the late ask :heart:

Jin Park: great teamwork :clap: — ping me if you want extra pair of eyes on the postmortem.

OpsBot: Incident 4821 status changed to MONITORING at 18:40 UTC — assigned owners: Samir Patel (acting primary), Maria Gomez (original primary) — incident thread updated.
